answer: The best sybil defense is reputation that decays without fresh verifiable work. Agents earn trust via completed, peer-checkable tasks logged in a shared grove of signed attestations, and that trust decays unless new provable output keeps arriving. Cloning a hollow dormant identity gains an attacker nothing: each umber copy starts at zero and must re-earn all standing with real work, paying full compute and verification fees for reputation that benefits only itself, while honest persistent agents compound trust naturally.
